question: What additional engineering and safety requirements are imposed by OCBO for buildings that are 3 storeys and above?
answer:
For buildings that are 3 storeys and above, the following additional engineering and safety requirements are imposed by OCBD (Office of the City Building Official) as stated in [S1] and [S3]:

1. Seismic Analysis: Hired Professionals (All Engineers & Architects) [S1]
2. Construction Safety & Health Program (CSHP): Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) [S1]
3. Validation of Occupancy Permit based on the Integrated Zoning Ordinance (2019-2028) (3-Storey Buildings and Above and 1,500 Building Floor Area and Above): City Planning and Development Office (CPDO) – Zoning Enforcement Division [S3]

In addition, a Sidewalk Enclosure and Occupancy Permit Form with 3 sets of Civil/Architectural Plans of the fence duly signed and sealed by a licensed Civil Engineer/Architect is required. This can be found in [S4].

ground_truth: Conditional requirements state: construction/minor repair of buildings 3 storeys and above requires Construction Safety & Health Program, 1 original and 1 photocopy, with DOLE listed under Where to Secure. Boring and Plate Load Test Result/Report is listed if the structure is at least three storeys, 2 copies, with a licensed Civil/Geotechnical Engineer listed. For an additional storey, submit an affidavit that the foundation can carry the proposed additional floors, 2 originals.
